idea-plugin.name: Shamash
idea-plugin.description:
Understand source dependencies in Java and Kotlin projects.

Shamash helps investigate package dependency cycles, explore relationships between source declarations, and navigate to supporting references. Start with Analyze project; it does not require a Shamash configuration, application build, or report export.

Source relationships are advisory; existing project architecture policies are not evaluated by the IDE experience. For build-time enforcement, reports, baselines and custom rules, visit Shamash on GitHub.

Plugin source is Apache-2.0; core dependencies are AGPL-3.0-only. See bundled licenses and source metadata.

action.text: Shamash: Analyze Source (legacy Run Source Scan)
Shamash: Analyze Source (legacy Run Build Scan)

idea-plugin.change-notes:
Source-first experience

  • One Shamash tool window with Findings and Explore for Java/Kotlin source dependencies.
  • Existing configurations, reports and baselines remain available to the standalone CLI.
  • Retired plugin-only configuration, registry, export and automatic-fix actions.
